meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目新版本发布到 npm 并验证发布产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要一键把代码包发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version of your project to npm and verify the outputs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a code package to npm and confirm it succeeded

howto.what: 你说要发布时,Claude 会先确认版本升级类型(patch/minor/major),同步代码、触发 GitHub Actions 发布工作流,验证 npm 包和 GitHub 发布,写发布说明并发 Discord 公告。它只发布,不顺手改代码或做审查,除非你明确要求。
howto.when: 当你说出「publish」「release」「deploy」等触发词,或要求发布到 npm 时触发。它会先确认你要的版本升级类型(patch/minor/major);你没说,它会停下来问。

say.text: 发布一个 patch 版本
say.note: 自动升补丁版本,然后跑完整发布流程

say.text: 把最新改动以 minor 版本发布到 npm
say.note: 升次版本号,发布后验证 npm 和 GitHub

say.text: 用 major 版本发布,并记得发 Discord 公告
say.note: 主版本升级,发布完成后会在 Discord 发公告

howto.what_en: On publish: confirms bump type, syncs code, triggers the GitHub Actions workflow, verifies npm/GitHub release, drafts notes, posts to Discord. Ships only; no fixes unless asked.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like 'publish', 'release', 'deploy' (or asking to publish to npm). It first asks for the bump type (patch/minor/major) and stops to ask if none was provided.

say_en.note: Bumps the patch version and runs the full release workflow

say_en.text: Publish the latest changes to npm as a minor version
say_en.note: Bumps minor, verifies npm and GitHub after release

say_en.text: Release with a major version and remember to post the Discord announcement
say_en.note: Major bump; posts to Discord after release completes
